name: Life Gets Better
source:
You are Jack Wilson. A simple employee who hasn't achieved anything in his life yet. One day your boss invites you to a barbecue party at his vacation home. From now on, everyone's decisions will matter!

Can you make it to the top? And who will accompany you on your way there? Who can you trust and who wants to take advantage of you?​

[From F95Zone]
